newsitem.title: USA: Johnson applies for once-daily Risperdal.
newsitem.headline: Johnson applies for once-daily Risperdal.

text.p: Johnson & Johnson unit Janssen Pharmaceutica said on Monday it applied for U.S. Food and Drug Administration clearance to market a once-daily dosing regimen of its antipsychotic drug Risperdal.
Risperdal is now indicated for twice-daily administration with a target dose of three milligrams, for a total of six milligram a day.

A study submitted to the FDA and presented this week at the American College of Neuropsychopharmacology's annual meeting supported once-daily dosing of Risperdal for the treatment of schizophrenia, the company said.
